newsitem.title: USA: Ladenburg Thalmann names four new execs.
newsitem.headline: Ladenburg Thalmann names four new execs.

text.p: Boutique investment bank Ladenburg Thalmann, a unit of New Valley Corp, on Friday named four new executives.

The firm named Todd Berko, a former PaineWebber Group Inc analyst, as managing director of its research department. He formerly covered consolidating industries including death care, rural emergency services, personnel staffing, and auto wreckage.

It also named Paul Blackman as senior managing director, responsible for expanding its retail branch office network. Griff Peck was named managing director, director of over-the-counter (OTC) and Jim McCarthy was named vice president, OTC sales trading.
